mutation_targets.rationale: The deletion log must be append-only with no duplicate entries for the same task. Removing this fact allows multiple TaskDeletion records with the same task_id, which violates the uniqueness constraint essential to FR-018 (operational log integrity).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DupDeletion { some disj td1, td2: System.task_deletions | td1.task_id = td2.task_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Task titles must be non-empty (1-200 characters after trimming). Removing this fact allows empty titles to be created, directly violating the core input validation requirement from FR-005.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_EmptyTitle { some t: System.tasks | t.title = "" }

mutation_targets.rationale: Deleted tasks must be permanently removed from the task list. Removing this fact allows a task to simultaneously exist in System.tasks and have a deletion record in System.task_deletions, violating the permanence and non-recoverability of deletion.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RecoverableTask { some t: System.tasks | some td: System.task_deletions | td.task_id = t.id }
